\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 241-244 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R249-first-pass-words-from-chapters-241-244}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for juice and a tender coconut.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item regarding, although, and yet, however, if so
  \item at least, either, a difference, a matter, a situation
  \item an excuse, blame, responsibility, a possibility, a basis
  \item full, torn, sharp, private, public
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Regarding? (\textbf{\ml{സംബന്ധിച്ച്}}, \emph{sambandhiccŭ}.) Although? (\textbf{\ml{എങ്കിലും}}, \emph{eṅkiluṁ}.) And yet? (\textbf{\ml{എന്നിട്ടും}}, \emph{enniṭṭuṁ}.) However? (\textbf{\ml{എന്നിരുന്നാലും}}, \emph{ennirunnāluṁ}.) If so? (\textbf{\ml{എങ്കിൽ}}, \emph{eṅkil}.) At least? (\textbf{\ml{കുറഞ്ഞത്}}, \emph{kuṟaññatŭ}.) Either? (\textbf{\ml{ഒന്നുകിൽ}}, \emph{onnukil}.) A difference? (\textbf{\ml{വ്യത്യാസം}}, \emph{vyatyāsaṁ}.) A matter? (\textbf{\ml{കാര്യം}}, \emph{kāryaṁ}.) A situation? (\textbf{\ml{സാഹചര്യം}}, \emph{sāhacaryaṁ}.) An excuse? (\textbf{\ml{ഒഴികഴിവ്}}, \emph{oḻikaḻivŭ}.) Blame? (\textbf{\ml{കുറ്റം}}, \emph{kuṟṟaṁ}.) Responsibility? (\textbf{\ml{ഉത്തരവാദിത്തം}}, \emph{uttaravādittaṁ}.) A possibility? (\textbf{\ml{സാധ്യത}}, \emph{sādhyata}.) A basis? (\textbf{\ml{അടിസ്ഥാനം}}, \emph{aṭisthānaṁ}.) Full? (\textbf{\ml{നിറഞ്ഞ}}, \emph{niṟañña}.) Torn? (\textbf{\ml{കീറിയ}}, \emph{kīṟiya}.) Sharp? (\textbf{\ml{മൂർച്ചയുള്ള}}, \emph{mūrccayuḷḷa}.) Private? (\textbf{\ml{സ്വകാര്യ}}, \emph{svakārya}.) Public? (\textbf{\ml{പൊതു}}, \emph{potu}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 245-249 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R249-second-pass-words-from-chapters-245-249}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a colour and brown.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a colour, brown, grey, pink, violet
  \item traditional, popular, exciting, firm, broken
  \item double, elderly, bald, curly, orderly
  \item cooking gas, a tap, a carry bag, a skirt, jeans
  \item flour, wheat, bread, juice, a tender coconut
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A colour? (\textbf{\ml{നിറം}}, \emph{niṟaṁ}.) Brown? (\textbf{\ml{തവിട്ട്}}, \emph{taviṭṭŭ}.) Grey? (\textbf{\ml{ചാരനിറം}}, \emph{cāraniṟaṁ}.) Pink? (\textbf{\ml{പിങ്ക്}}, \emph{piṅkŭ}.) Violet? (\textbf{\ml{വയലറ്റ്}}, \emph{vayalaṟṟŭ}.) Traditional? (\textbf{\ml{പരമ്പരാഗത}}, \emph{paramparāgata}.) Popular? (\textbf{\ml{ജനപ്രിയമായ}}, \emph{janapriyamāya}.) Exciting? (\textbf{\ml{ആവേശകരമായ}}, \emph{āvēśakaramāya}.) Firm? (\textbf{\ml{ഉറപ്പുള്ള}}, \emph{uṟappuḷḷa}.) Broken? (\textbf{\ml{കേടായ}}, \emph{kēṭāya}.) Double? (\textbf{\ml{ഇരട്ട}}, \emph{iraṭṭa}.) Elderly? (\textbf{\ml{പ്രായമായ}}, \emph{prāyamāya}.) Bald? (\textbf{\ml{കഷണ്ടിയുള്ള}}, \emph{kaṣaṇṭiyuḷḷa}.) Curly? (\textbf{\ml{ചുരുണ്ട}}, \emph{curuṇṭa}.) Orderly? (\textbf{\ml{ചിട്ടയുള്ള}}, \emph{ciṭṭayuḷḷa}.) Cooking gas? (\textbf{\ml{ഗ്യാസ്}}, \emph{gyās}.) A tap? (\textbf{\ml{പൈപ്പ്}}, \emph{paippŭ}.) A carry bag? (\textbf{\ml{കവർ}}, \emph{kavar}.) A skirt? (\textbf{\ml{പാവാട}}, \emph{pāvāṭa}.) Jeans? (\textbf{\ml{ജീൻസ്}}, \emph{jīns}.) Flour? (\textbf{\ml{മാവ്}}, \emph{māvŭ}.) Wheat? (\textbf{\ml{ഗോതമ്പ്}}, \emph{gōtambŭ}.) Bread? (\textbf{\ml{റൊട്ടി}}, \emph{ṟoṭṭi}.) Juice? (\textbf{\ml{ജ്യൂസ്}}, \emph{jyūs}.) A tender coconut? (\textbf{\ml{കരിക്ക്}}, \emph{karikkŭ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
